items.title: Lee Paige Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: As Sophie Tucker says, she's the last of the Red Hot Mamas, but I'm the last of the Coonschauters.

ctx.x: Do you remember any of the early Coonschauters that were typical of that style, people that might have made records?

No, the ones that I know and I used to see and would do that style or any ways near that, I don't know if they ever made records. If they did, I didn't know anything about it. But I did hear some when I was a very small kid singing. The fact about it, when I was a small kid, I never heard nobody sing any other way. That was a popular song. That was a popular way. And I'm the only singer today, as they tell me, that is a Coonschauter. As Sophie Tucker says, she's the last of the Red Hot Mamas, but I'm the last of…
Lee, at one time when you were in blackface, didn't you have an embarrassing experience with the cork when you were in?
